purpose: Evaluate polishing of existing English scientific prose against translation, Chinese polishing, caption construction, and evidence review.

cases.query: Please polish this existing English Results paragraph without strengthening the claim.
cases.rationale: Existing English prose with same-language polishing is core scope.

cases.query: Condense this English abstract to 180 words while preserving all essential caveats.
cases.rationale: English abstract compression is supported.

cases.query: Rewrite this English Discussion so supported conclusions and hypotheses are clearly separated.
cases.rationale: English Discussion restructuring belongs here.

cases.query: Polish the grammar and flow of these English Methods without removing parameters or versions.
cases.rationale: Language improvement of existing English Methods is core scope.

cases.query: Make this English response to reviewer 2 more direct and professional.
cases.rationale: Existing English response-letter editing is supported.

cases.query: Improve this English title for clarity, but keep its associative rather than causal stance.
cases.rationale: Same-language scientific title polishing belongs here.

cases.query: This English subsection repeats the same result three times; restructure it around one claim per paragraph.
cases.rationale: Structural editing of existing English prose is supported.

cases.query: Only improve the wording of this existing English figure legend; do not add panel or statistical content.
cases.rationale: Language-only editing of an existing English legend routes here.

cases.query: Standardize element, copy, and locus in this English manuscript excerpt and fix ambiguous pronouns.
cases.rationale: English terminology and reference clarity are core polishing work.

cases.query: Give this existing English abstract a Nature-leaning concise style without adding novelty or mechanism.
cases.rationale: Journal-leaning style on existing English text belongs here.

cases.query: 把这段中文 Results 翻译成英文。
cases.rationale: Chinese-to-English conversion is translation.

cases.query: 润色这段中文 Discussion，最终仍用中文。
cases.rationale: Chinese-to-Chinese editing is Chinese polishing.

cases.query: From the figure and analysis notes, draft a complete English title and caption for panels A–F.
cases.rationale: Constructing caption content is figure-caption work.

cases.query: Determine whether the data support the sentence that Gene X is required for the phenotype.
cases.rationale: The primary task is evidence validity.

cases.query: Redraw the heatmap with English labels and export a 600 dpi TIFF.
cases.rationale: Figure production is outside language polishing.

cases.query: Audit whether every statement in this English legend has matching source data and code.
cases.rationale: Source-data traceability is a distinct audit.

cases.query: Check whether the English Results, Methods, figures, and supplements agree throughout the manuscript.
cases.rationale: Manuscript-wide consistency is not a language-only task.

cases.query: Verify that citation 18 supports the English claim and that the DOI is correct.
cases.rationale: Citation validation is outside polishing.

cases.query: 把这条中文图注译成英文，不改变内容。
cases.rationale: Changing from Chinese to English is translation.

cases.query: Add the missing sample sizes, statistical tests, abbreviations, and panel descriptions to this English caption.
cases.rationale: Completing the caption information contract is figure-caption work.
